question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**shatter**" means to break suddenly and violently into pieces. (टुकड़े-टुकड़े कर देना)
 
• In this context, "Unseasonal rains at the time of the harvest will shatter all hopes of a successful crop" makes the most sense, indicating that the hopes will be completely destroyed.
 
• The other options: "**piece**," "**form**," and "**clasp**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** Unseasonal rains at the time of the harvest will **shatter**__ all hopes of a successful crop, said a farmer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Piece **(टुकड़ा): A portion of an object or of material.

 
 
• **Example:** He broke a piece of the chocolate bar.
 
 
 
• **Form **(रूप): The visible shape or configuration of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The form of the structure is quite unique.
 
 
 
• **Clasp **(जकड़ना): Grip; hold tightly.
 
 
• **Example:** She clasped her hands in excitement.
